text:
Maya: Quick UX check 320px breakpoint. Filter rail is eating table width. Thinking of collapsing groups into a sticky chip row above the compare table.

Juan: Prototype: chips for groups, horizontal scroll, overflow for rare groups. Keeps compare columns wider.

Kevin: Perf badges (latency/cost) are cramped. Proposal: single 'Perf' token with chevron to expand inline. Not tooltip-only.

Aria: Accessibility: chips must be buttons with aria-pressed, focus ring; perf token needs aria-expanded and keyboard control; expanded panel must be focusable and respect prefers-reduced-motion. Announce pin insertions via aria-live.

Maya: Product decisions: pin should auto-insert a left pinned column and chips mirror pin state with a small persistent icon + sr-only text.

Juan: Dev notes: animate column insertion, preserve scrollLeft, keyboard handlers for chips (Enter/Space), 24px tap targets. Estimate 3 dev days + a11y QA.

DesignBot: Scheduling follow-up accessibility review next Tue 10am PT.

Maya: I'll update Figma and ping when ready.
